name: Lucky Starter
source:
Lucky Starters is a government social program that explores two main characters of two different species: Vulcan Harvey, a Ram Farhie, and Cobalt Ray, a Human. They learn about one another despite having a rough start in assuming each others' stereotypes and looks. 

[From [url=https://waterhusky.itch.io/lucky-starter]Itch.io[/url]]
